#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""usage: python3 confere.py base.md transcript.txt
Is each quoted excerpt from the source in the transcript? Exits 1 if any are missing."""
import re, sys, unicodedata

def n(s):  # lowercase, no accents, no punctuation
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s.lower()).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9%]+", " ", s)).strip()

base = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read()
tx = n(open(sys.argv[2], encoding="utf-8").read())
fora = 0
for trecho in re.findall(r'"([^"]{20,})"', base):
    ok = n(trecho) in tx
    fora += not ok
    print("OK  " if ok else "FORA", trecho[:70])
sys.exit(1 if fora else 0)

[Unit]\nDescription=<canal> — rodada dia:

[Service]

systemctl --user enable --now <canal>-diario.timer
systemctl --user list-timers '<canal>-*'

<p>Com <code>Persistent=false</code>, um: With Persistent=false, a missed run (the machine is off at 02:00) does not run late when the machine comes back on. For a daily radar, a video about yesterday published in the afternoon is no use.
<p><code>TimeoutStartSec</code> e <code>: TimeoutStartSec and MemoryMax are limits: a run that gets stuck is stopped, and one that uses too much memory won’t bring the machine down. A run with no limit that gets stuck at 02:00 is still stuck at 09:00.
